scope: All 71 tool records across the seven RupeeKit tool datasets (70 live routes plus the one already-consolidated record)

evidence.authoritativeBaseline: GitHub issue #57, page-level GSC export for 2026-07-04 through 2026-08-05
evidence.note: The Day-10 report has no fresh page rows. Decisions therefore use the authoritative #57 page-level evidence, Day-9 link/canonical audit, ship dates, and the issue-78 rule to be conservative with pages shipped after about 20 July. No zero-traffic page is retired solely because fresh traffic data is unavailable.

classificationDefinitions.keep-and-invest: Has demonstrated demand or is a differentiated core calculator with a clear place in an established cluster.
classificationDefinitions.keep-too-new: Shipped after about 20 July 2026 and needs a fair measurement window before traffic-based judgement.
classificationDefinitions.merge: Duplicate intent; unique value belongs in a stronger survivor and the loser must permanently redirect.
classificationDefinitions.fix-discovery: Differentiated page with demonstrated or plausible demand whose main remaining weakness is internal discovery/link support.
classificationDefinitions.retire: No demonstrated demand, no meaningful differentiation, and no discovery value after a fair measurement window. None meet this bar in this run.

coverage.note: The first pass of this registry covered 59 of the 64 records that were live on 25 August 2026. The five omitted records (mutual-fund, retirement, stock-portfolio, and the two 8th CPC arrears/pension calculators) and the seven policy-lane calculators shipped on 26 August in #131 were added when this registry was merged to main, so the registry now covers every live tool record.
